topic: Senate vote mismatch - Russia sanctions claim vs actual early childhood education bill
tweet1: @EricLDaugh claimed the Senate voted 86-12 on Russia sanctions with Zelensky present. The C-SPAN graphic shows they actually voted on the 'Supporting Early-childhood Educators' Deductions Act.'
tweet2: The post got 177 likes, 53 retweets. Video clearly shows 'H.R. 5334, Supporting Early-childhood Educators' Deductions Act' on screen. Not sanctions. Not Russia. A tax deduction bill for preschool teachers.
tweet3: This isn't spin — it's fabrication with receipts attached. The mismatch works because most people don't pause video to read C-SPAN chyrons. They see 'ZELENSKY' + 'SENATE VOTE' and fill in the story themselves.
tweet4: Check every 'BREAKING' claim with visible documentation. If the source provides proof that contradicts their own caption, they're counting on you not to look. Has anyone compiled a list of these self-refuting posts?
